panels.description: Adrian’s hologram appears above the workbench and looks toward Alex, who is a silhouette in the foreground with thumb over the watch. Keep upper-left clear.
Alex’s set jaw and bright eyes in blue hologram light. No lettering.
Adrian’s hologram at left, Alex at center and Grandmother in the bookshelf doorway. Leave upper corners clear.
Adrian turns serious as the hologram shifts burgundy; Grandmother’s hand presses to her chest. Reserve separate zones for two apology balloons, keeping both faces visible.
Adrian leans toward the lens as scan lines begin. Reserve upper-left and lower-right for two instruction balloons.
The hologram is gone. Alex sits in blue-grey afterglow with Bi11bot’s amber eyes at frame edge and unfolds Adrian’s photograph. No lettering.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Hello, Alex. If you're seeing this... then you found the workshop.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Which means your grandmother still refuses to throw anything away.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: If you're watching this, I wasn't there when you needed me. I'm sorry. To you, and to Mom.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: I made one bad call. I thought I was right. But I was wrong.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: I got things wrong, Alex. More than once. But every failure taught me something.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: You don't have to finish what I started. You may find a better way.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Bi11bot has a map. What you do with it is up to you. And whatever he tells you... question everything. Especially me.
